description: Get a tag by name. NOTE: GitFlic returns 400 for project-scoped tag get; prefer tag list.

fields.description: Return only these top-level fields (plus id keys), narrowing the response further.

raw.description: Return the full, un-slimmed GitFlic response for THIS call (no token compression). Use when the default slim view dropped a field you need.

name: gitflic_tag_get
